content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. or M.Tech. in Environmental Science, Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Geology, Earth Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a closely related discipline from a recognised university; Valid NET or GATE qualification (mandatory) Experience: Desirable: experience in environmental sample collection and preparation, trace metal analysis, analytical instrumentation (AAS/ICP-MS/ICP-OES), environmental geochemistry, or human exposure assessment Age limit: Maximum 30 years Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PWD As allowed following Government of India rules Other conditions: Project may involve collaboration with national and international research institutions Desirable: Experience in environmental sample collection and preparation, trace metal analysis, analytical instrumentation (AAS/ICP-MS/ICP-OES), environmental geochemistry, or human exposure assessment Previous research experience, fieldwork experience and publications in relevant areas

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Duration three years, subject to satisfactory performance and availability of project funds Appointment initially for one year, may be extended based on performance and project requirements Purely temporary and co-terminus with the project No claim for regular appointment or absorption at Jadavpur University

content_sections.heading: How Will JU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting Interview Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email of the date and mode of interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form Updated curriculum vitae (CV) Copies of educational certificates and mark sheets Proof of NET/GATE qualification Copies of publications, if any

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JU Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Obtain the paper application form from the Information Section of Jadavpur University or download it from the university's download centre (Application Form – Research (2 in a Set)). Compile the application form, updated CV, certificates and mark sheets, NET/GATE proof, experience certificates and publications into a single PDF file. Email the PDF to [email protected] . Use the email subject: Application for JRF Position – Coefficient Giving BLL Project. Send the application by 12 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form is priced at Rs. 50/- from the Information Section of Jadavpur University All documents must be compiled into a single PDF file No House Rent Allowance (HRA) will be provided No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in JU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for JU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 12 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.answer: The maximum age is 30 years. Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PWD As allowed following Government of India rules.

faq.answer: Yes. Project may involve collaboration with national and international research institutions.

faq.answer: Shortlisting. Interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email of the date and mode of interview.
